race.comment: MISS OUT (4) was responsible for a very good effort last time over 1800m at Globe Derby Park, finishing second and just 1.75 metres from the winner. Good enough to take out a race like this. GUEST ARTIST NZ (3) led last time out and saluted at this track over 1790m, getting home by 3.5 metres. That followed an encouraging minor placing here the start prior. Likely to get all the favours from this nice draw and his recent effort is good enough to win a race of this calibre. WIPEOUT (9) is the next elect off a last-start win by 3 metres at this circuit over 2190m. Can go back-to-back. LETSGO BIG GIRL (5) is the best of the rest after finishing fifth over 1790m at this course last time out.
